title: rumex aquaticus subsp. tomentellus
intro: Rumex aquaticus subsp. tomentellus, commonly known as water dock, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Polygonaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and gout. The therapeutic actions of water dock include reducing inflammation, fighting free radicals, and potentially lowering blood pressure. The bioactive constituents present in water dock include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
